This '''blue-bladed lightsaber''' belonged to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] after his resurrection on [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].

==History==
[[File:L_versus_s.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] using the lightsaber to battle [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].]]
In his [[Clone Labs|lab]] on the Imperial throne-world, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] kept a number of stolen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in case he needed them, one of which was blue-bladed.<ref name="DE 5">[[Dark Empire 5|''Dark Empire'' 5]]</ref>

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] destroyed all but one of Palpatine's clones, but Palpatine's essence [[Essence transfer|moved into]] the one clone that Luke hadn't destroyed yet and the newly-possessed clone grabbed his blue-bladed lightsaber from the wall of the lab and used it to [[Duel on Byss|duel Luke]]. He won the duel and got Luke to turn to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and become his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]].<ref name="DE 5" />

Later in 10 ABY, he discovered onboard his [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']] that Luke renounced the dark side thanks to the efforts of his twin sister, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. Enraged, Palpatine used his blue-bladed lightsaber to attack Luke. Despite the Emperor's ferocious power, he was caught off guard by Skywalker, losing his hand to his opponents's weapon and dropping his own. Mere minutes later, the ''Eclipse'' was destroyed along with Palpatine's clone and the stolen lightsaber.<ref name="DE 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
While [[Cam Kennedy]]'s comic panel art throughout ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire|Dark Empire]]'' portrays Palpatine's lightsaber as blue-bladed, [[Dave Dorman]]'s cover art for issues [[Dark Empire 5|5]] and [[Dark Empire 6|6]] portray it as white and red, respectively. In the case of ''Dark Empire'' 6, this inconsistency in blade color between page and cover also exists for Luke and Leia's sabers (red and blue, respectively, to green). In addition, ''[[Star Wars Handbook 3: Dark Empire]]'' depicts the young Palpatine clone wielding a green-bladed lightsaber.
